summary: Backend + Frontend testing of refactored Phase 1 Analytics Engine (v1.0.0). Backend refactored into 4 modules; all 10 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend all 6 dashboard tabs render real Navixy data correctly with audit banner, null-field handling (N/A), and fuel-config prompt.

minor.issue: Cannot reset a field (e.g. default_consumption_rate) to null via PUT because the handler ignores None values. Only way to clear is direct DB manipulation.

issues: Console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from ResponsiveContainer at initial mount - cosmetic, charts still render

passed_tests: GET /api/fleet/stats returns _audit with engine_version, navixy_calls, data_quality + real vehicles
GET /api/analytics/trends returns per-day total_distance & active_vehicles (real); avg_efficiency/total_driving_time/total_idle_time/speed_violations all null
PUT /api/config/fuel {default_consumption_rate:8.5} → subsequent /api/fleet/stats include fuel_used_liters + fuel_cost_chf on vehicles with distance
GET /api/reports/driver returns drivers with real distance data (no journal errors)

Frontend Overview: UTILISATION FLOTTE 32%, VEHICULES CONNECTES 2/12, DISTANCE 3987km, TEMPS MOTEUR 2218h with data source banner 'Toutes les donnees proviennent directement de l\'API Navixy — aucune estimation | Engine v1.0.0'
Frontend Performance: utilization scores + Top 10 by distance
Frontend Vehicles: UTILISATION column shown with % per vehicle
Frontend Efficiency: utilization % bars per vehicle with active_days/total_days (e.g. 5/7j | 762 km)
Frontend Costs: 'Configuration carburant requise' prompt shown when no consumption rate configured, CARBURANT/COUT MENSUEL display N/A
Frontend Drivers: driver list with utilization-based scores (Ivan 71, Orhan 57)
action_items: Optional: consider supporting explicit null reset in PUT /api/config/fuel (e.g. treat explicit null via sentinel or a separate DELETE endpoint) so config can be cleared through API
Optional: fix Recharts ResponsiveContainer(-1) warnings by giving containers explicit minHeight/minWidth
critical_code_review_comments: analytics_engine.py is 718 lines — consider splitting into per-KPI modules (>700 line threshold)
server.py fuel PUT handler drops None values, preventing config reset — surface via API for admin ops
backend/tests/backend_test.py directly manipulates mongo tenant_config to reset state — indicates missing admin reset endpoint
test_credentials: None required. NAVIXY_HASH pre-configured in backend .env.
seed_data_creation: None — live Navixy API data. Fixture resets tenant_config collection before/after test module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Engine v1.0.0 confirmed working. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py can be re-run any time (module-scoped fixture cleans mongo tenant_config for tenant='default' before/after). Trends endpoint uses field names total_distance/total_driving_time/total_idle_time (not distance/driving_time/idle_time). Navixy API is slow (7-15s per aggregated call) — allow generous timeouts. Recharts dimension warnings are cosmetic only.
